info.name: Receive the list of custom and standard audiences with IDs

params.name: includeStdAuds
params.description: include std audiences along with custom audiences

params.name: search
params.description: restrict to audiences that match according to fuzzy-search

params.name: page_size
params.description: number of audiences per page (default 100, max 10000)

params.name: offset
params.description: Optional page selector RELATIVE to page_token: 1 = next page (the default when a page_token is supplied), -1 = previous page, 0 = reload the current page. Has no effect without page_token.

params.name: page_token
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response's pagination.pageToken. Pass it alone to fetch the next page; pagination is cursor-based and offset defaults to the next page when a page_token is supplied.
